title: Handoff and spawn-from-thread create siblings instead of children, so second opinions pile up beside the thread
body:
### The workflow

One thread does the work; I ask another model to check it, or pick up where the first left off. bb has everything for this: threads carry `parentThreadId`, the sidebar renders children as a tree under their parent, the thread view lists child threads, and the CLI accepts `--parent-self`.

Steps (bb 0.40.0, macOS desktop app):

1. In a thread, open the model picker and press **Handoff to new thread**.
2. Or, in a thread, ask the agent to have another model review the work; it runs `bb thread spawn --project … --prompt …`.

### What happens today

Both paths create a **sibling**, not a child.

- Handoff seeds the composer with `Continue from @thread` ([thread-handoff-request.ts#L69-L90](https://github.com/get-bb/bb/blob/688eb4251c5b5c53c5a56f85baae6d47966355ec/packages/client-core/src/prompt/thread-handoff-request.ts#L69-L90)) and the root composer reads the seed only to build that draft ([RootComposeView.tsx#L742-L777](https://github.com/get-bb/bb/blob/688eb4251c5b5c53c5a56f85baae6d47966355ec/apps/app/src/views/RootComposeView.tsx#L742-L777)); the create request carries no `parentThreadId`, so the mention is the only link and the sidebar shows two unrelated rows. Handoff also navigates straight to the project compose route ([ThreadDetailPromptArea.tsx#L935-L943](https://github.com/get-bb/bb/blob/688eb4251c5b5c53c5a56f85baae6d47966355ec/apps/app/src/views/thread-detail/ThreadDetailPromptArea.tsx#L935-L943)), which replaces the focused pane (the same shape as #2795).
- `bb thread spawn` inside a thread leaves parenting opt-in ([spawn.ts#L81-L100](https://github.com/get-bb/bb/blob/688eb4251c5b5c53c5a56f85baae6d47966355ec/apps/cli/src/commands/thread/spawn.ts#L81-L100), and the guide's "Parenting is opt-in"). Agents do not reliably pass `--parent-self`, and every miss is a sibling with the same title.

After two rounds of this I had three threads called "Юнит-экономика" side by side and no way to tell which was the review and on which model.

### What you would expect

- Handoff creates the new thread **as a child of the thread it continues**, and opens the composer beside the current pane.
- `bb thread spawn` from inside a thread parents the new thread to the current one **by default**; `--no-parent` opts out for a genuinely unrelated thread, `--parent-thread <id>` attaches it elsewhere. The guide says so.
- A child row in the sidebar **names the model it runs on** (its pinned model, else the provider), because the point of a child is usually "the same work on another model". That needs `model` on thread list entries; the thread's `model_override` is already in the row.

### Notes

Prototype (not a PR, per CONTRIBUTING): https://github.com/Techno911/bb/commit/4eab28826

The default-parenting change flips one CLI test ("does not default parent thread id from BB_THREAD_ID"); happy to keep opt-in if there is a reason I am missing, but for the review-by-another-model workflow the default is what makes the tree appear at all.
